naming_basis: deterministic reconstruction order (design/assembly.json instances + build_cad.components); STEP product names are generic
manufacturing_process: unfilled PC FDM candidate, segmented nominal ~3 mm shell; panel outer face supported on build plate, 6 perimeters at ~0.42 mm line width plus solid gap fill, 100% nominal modeled wall volume (no second infill deduction); panel orientation/seam adhesion unqualified
thermal_condition: dry PC filament, enclosed heated chamber/bed and measured cold-zone exposure assumed; actual grade/warpage/layer impact strength and process validation HOLD
bounds_basis: 0.85..1.10 x nominal PC solid-shell mass per CAD volume: print voids and dimensional/warpage sensitivity, NOT bulk PC density range
inertia_basis: bbox-center assumed COM; uniform box diagonal estimate at BRep-volume mass; true COM/tensor unmeasured, per-axis upper bound for any mass within bbox (at bbox center)
mass_source: imported STEP solid BRep volume x effective material density; no per-solid BRep inertia extraction
